SELECT 
    s.CharterNum,
    AVG(f.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.Charter = 1
GROUP BY 
    s.CharterNum
ORDER BY 
    AvgWritingScore DESC;

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.CharterNum, AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore
